review.shortfall_reason: Partial publishable batch: 11 of 20 concepts accepted, 9 Nikon-dependent concepts rejected after discovering explicit AI-agent access restrictions in Nikon Terms of Use section 17 (updated August 26, 2026). No written authorization is evidenced; no further Nikon requests were made. All 14 cited article bodies were reopened before that discovery; only 9 sources support accepted records, with 33 per-field checks. Six accepted concepts explicitly enrich existing IDs; five are distinct metadata concepts. Compared all 32 same-category originals; lens classes and format equivalence are not wording-only variants, and deep focus is not merely layered composition. Zero proposals, measurements, direct media observations or media candidates in this batch; zero media acquired. Columbia remains restricted and Sony/Film Education reuse remains unknown. No open-media or commercial-use permission is implied. Restricted Nikon sources were not silently replaced because producer edits are outside reviewer scope; a replacement batch needs a new hash-bound review.
